ينتبه (form VIII)
# يَنْتَبِهُ (yantabihu) /jan.ta.bi.hu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# يُنْتَبَهُ (yuntabahu) /jun.ta.ba.hu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# يَنْتَبِهَ (yantabiha) /jan.ta.bi.ha/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# يُن
